records.source: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
records.gloss: And spoke Yahweh to Moses, saying,
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses,

L.1: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Moses, saying,

decisions.choice: spoke ... saying: the opening of a divine speech
decisions.reason: The formula introduces God's last instructions in the book (verses 2-15): how the tabernacle, made in chapters 36-39, is to be set up and anointed, and how the priests are to be installed.

decisions.choice: said
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the plain verb; Literal keeps "spoke ... saying".

records.heading: Instructions to set up the tabernacle

records.source: בְּיוֹם־הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ תָּקִ֕ים אֶת־מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
records.gloss: On [the] day of the month the first, on [the] first of the month, you will set up the tabernacle of [the] tent of meeting.
pieces: "On the first day of the first month, set up the tabernacle, the tent of meeting.

L.2: "On the day of the first month, on the first of the month, you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

R.2: "On the first day of the first month, set up the tabernacle, the sacred tent. It is the tent of meeting.

decisions.choice: on the first day of the first month: New Year's Day
decisions.reason: The date is given twice, as "the day of the first month" and "the first of the month": the first day of the first month, the month of the Passover (12:2). Verse 17 says which year: the second year after Israel left Egypt.

decisions.choice: the tabernacle of the tent of meeting: one structure with two names
alternatives: the tabernacle and the tent of meeting
decisions.reason: "Tabernacle" (dwelling) names the place where God lives among his people; "tent of meeting" names it as the place where he meets with them (29:42-43). The phrase joins the two names for the one tent.

decisions.choice: the tabernacle, the tent of meeting
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable set the second name beside the first; Literal keeps "the tabernacle of the tent of meeting".

decisions.choice: the sacred tent
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word "tabernacle" the first time it appears in the chapter, as 25:9 and 26:1 do.

records.source: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְסַכֹּתָ֥ עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן אֶת־הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
records.gloss: And you will put there the ark of the testimony, and you will screen over the ark the veil.
pieces: Place the ark of the testimony in it, and screen the ark off with the curtain.

L.3: And you shall put there the ark of the testimony, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

R.3: Put the ark that holds the covenant tablets inside it. Then hang the inner curtain in front of the ark to screen it off.

decisions.choice: screen the ark with the veil: shut it off from view
alternatives: cover the ark with the veil
decisions.reason: The verb means to cover or shield. The veil does not lie on the ark; it hangs in front of it and divides the most holy place from the holy place (26:33).

decisions.choice: the ark of the testimony: the chest that holds the tablets
decisions.reason: "The testimony" is the stone tablets of the covenant (25:16; 31:18), and the ark is named for them.

decisions.choice: curtain
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "curtain" (Readable "inner curtain"), as in 26:31-35; Literal keeps "veil".

decisions.choice: the ark that holds the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the ark of the testimony" is, as in 25:22.

records.source: וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן וְעָרַכְתָּ֖ אֶת־עֶרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֔ה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ֖ אֶת־נֵרֹתֶֽיהָ׃
records.gloss: And you will bring in the table, and you will arrange its arrangement; and you will bring in the lampstand, and you will set up its lamps.
pieces: Bring in the table and set out in order what belongs on it. Bring in the lampstand and mount its lamps.

L.4: And you shall bring in the table and set in order its arrangement, and you shall bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.

R.4: Bring in the table and lay out the bread on it in rows. Bring in the lampstand and put its lamps in place.

decisions.choice: its arrangement: the bread set out in rows
decisions.reason: The noun means things laid out in order. Verse 23 calls it "an arrangement of bread": the bread of the Presence, set out in two rows (25:30; Leviticus 24:5-6).

decisions.choice: set up its lamps: mount the lamps on the lampstand
decisions.reason: The verb means to raise up. Here it most likely means placing the seven lamps on top of the lampstand (25:37). It may also mean lighting them (see verse 25).

decisions.choice: lay out the bread on it in rows
decisions.reason: Readable says what the arrangement was, from verse 23.

records.source: וְנָתַתָּ֞ה אֶת־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַזָּהָב֙ לִקְטֹ֔רֶת לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת וְשַׂמְתָּ֛ אֶת־מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
records.gloss: And you will put the altar of the gold for incense before [the] ark of the testimony, and you will put the screen of the entrance to the tabernacle.
pieces: Place the gold altar for incense in front of the ark of the testimony, and hang the screen at the entrance to the tabernacle.

L.5: And you shall put the altar of gold for incense before the ark of the testimony, and you shall put [in place] the screen of the entrance to the tabernacle.

R.5: Put the gold altar for burning incense in front of the ark that holds the covenant tablets, on the outer side of the inner curtain. Then hang the screen at the entrance to the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: before the ark: in front of the veil that hides the ark
decisions.reason: The incense altar stood in the holy place, outside the veil, facing the ark behind it (30:6; 40:26). It was not inside the most holy place.

decisions.choice: the screen of the entrance: the hanging at the door of the tent
decisions.reason: This is the embroidered screen at the doorway of the tent itself (26:36-37), not the screen at the gate of the courtyard (verse 8).

decisions.choice: on the outer side of the inner curtain
decisions.reason: Readable says where the altar stood, so that "in front of the ark" is not read as inside the most holy place.

records.source: וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֕י פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֥ן אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵֽד׃
records.gloss: And you will put the altar of the burnt offering before [the] entrance of [the] tabernacle of [the] tent of meeting.
pieces: Set the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting.

L.6: And you shall put the altar of burnt offering before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

R.6: Put the altar for burnt offerings in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting.

decisions.choice: the altar of burnt offering: the bronze altar in the courtyard
decisions.reason: The large altar of acacia wood overlaid with bronze (27:1-8) stood in the courtyard, in front of the tent's entrance, where the offerings were burned.

records.source: וְנָֽתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖ם מָֽיִם׃
records.gloss: And you will put the basin between [the] tent of meeting and the altar, and you will put there water.
pieces: Place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

L.7: And you shall put the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and you shall put water there.

R.7: Put the bronze basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and fill it with water.

decisions.choice: the basin: the bronze washbasin for the priests
decisions.reason: The basin of bronze held water for the priests to wash their hands and feet before they served (30:17-21; verses 30-32).

decisions.choice: bronze
decisions.reason: Readable adds what the basin was made of (30:18).

records.source: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֑יב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ אֶת־מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃
records.gloss: And you will set up the courtyard all around, and you will put the screen of [the] gate of the courtyard.
pieces: Set up the courtyard all around it, and hang the screen at the gate of the courtyard.

L.8: And you shall set up the courtyard all around, and you shall put [in place] the screen of the gate of the courtyard.

R.8: Set up the courtyard all around it, and hang the screen at the courtyard's gate.

decisions.choice: the courtyard and its gate: the linen enclosure around the tent
decisions.reason: The courtyard was fenced with linen hangings on posts, with an embroidered screen across its gate on the east side (27:9-16).

records.source: וְלָקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
records.gloss: And you will take [the] oil of the anointing, and you will anoint the tabernacle and all that [is] in it, and you will consecrate it and all its articles, and it will be holy.
pieces: Then take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it. Consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.

L.9: And you shall take the oil of anointing and anoint the tabernacle and all that [is] in it, and you shall consecrate it and all its articles, and it shall be holy.

R.9: Then take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything inside it. In this way you will set it and all its furnishings apart for God, and it will be holy.

decisions.choice: the anointing oil: the holy oil made by the recipe of 30:22-33
decisions.reason: The oil was made only for this use (30:31-33). Putting it on the tent, its furnishings and the priests marked them as belonging to God.

decisions.choice: consecrate ... holy: set apart as belonging to God
decisions.reason: To consecrate is to make holy: to set something apart from common use for God's service alone.

decisions.choice: set ... apart for God
decisions.reason: Readable explains "consecrate", as in 30:29; Literal and Balanced keep "consecrate".

records.source: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֛ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִֽׁים׃
records.gloss: And you will anoint [the] altar of the burnt offering and all its articles, and you will consecrate the altar, and will be the altar holiness of holinesses.
pieces: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils. Consecrate the altar, and it will be most holy.

L.10: And you shall anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its articles, and you shall consecrate the altar, and the altar shall be holy of holies.

R.10: Anoint the altar for burnt offerings and all the things used with it. Set the altar apart for God, and it will be most holy.

decisions.choice: holy of holies: most holy
decisions.reason: Repeating the noun in the plural makes a superlative. The altar is "most holy", as in 29:37, where anything that touches it becomes holy.

decisions.choice: most holy
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the superlative; Literal keeps "holy of holies".

records.source: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: And you will anoint the basin and its stand, and you will consecrate it.
pieces: Anoint the basin with its stand, and consecrate it.

L.11: And you shall anoint the basin and its stand, and you shall consecrate it.

R.11: Anoint the bronze basin and its stand, and set it apart for God.

decisions.choice: its stand: the base the basin rested on
decisions.reason: The noun is the base or stand of the basin, also made of bronze (30:18; 38:8).

decisions.choice: set it apart for God
decisions.reason: Readable explains "consecrate", as in verse 9.

records.source: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֤ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃
records.gloss: And you will bring near Aaron and his sons to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting, and you will wash them with water.
pieces: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.

L.12: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons near to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and you shall wash them with water.

R.12: Have Aaron and his sons come to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and wash them with water.

decisions.choice: wash them with water: the washing that began the priests' ordination
decisions.reason: These verses sum up the ordination of chapter 29 (29:4-9). The washing came first; Leviticus 8:6 tells how Moses did it.

records.source: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ וְכִהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃
records.gloss: And you will clothe Aaron [with] the garments of holiness, and you will anoint him, and you will consecrate him, and he will serve as priest to me.
pieces: Dress Aaron in the holy garments, anoint him and consecrate him, so that he may serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priest.

L.13: And you shall clothe Aaron [with] the garments of holiness, and anoint him and consecrate him, and he shall serve as priest to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

R.13: Put the holy clothes on Aaron. Anoint him and set him apart for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, so that he can serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priest.

decisions.choice: the garments of holiness: the high priest's holy clothing
decisions.reason: These are the garments made for Aaron in chapter 28 (28:2-4): the ephod, breastpiece, robe, tunic, turban and sash.

decisions.choice: he will serve as priest to me: the purpose of the anointing
decisions.reason: The last verb states the result and purpose of the clothing and anointing: Aaron is set apart to serve God as priest.

decisions.choice: set him apart for me
decisions.reason: Readable explains "consecrate" by saying for whom Aaron is set apart.

records.source: וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃
records.gloss: And his sons you will bring near, and you will clothe them [with] tunics.
pieces: Then bring his sons forward and put tunics on them.

L.14: And his sons you shall bring near, and you shall clothe them [with] tunics.

R.14: Then have his sons come forward, and dress them in tunics.

decisions.choice: tunics: the priests' long linen garments
decisions.reason: Aaron's sons wore linen tunics with sashes and caps (28:40), not the high priest's ephod and breastpiece.

records.source: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מָשַׁ֨חְתָּ֙ אֶת־אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וְכִהֲנ֖וּ לִ֑י וְ֠הָיְתָה לִהְיֹ֨ת לָהֶ֧ם מָשְׁחָתָ֛ם לִכְהֻנַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃
records.gloss: And you will anoint them just as you anointed their father, and they will serve as priests to me; and it will be, to be to them their anointing for a priesthood of perpetuity to their generations.
pieces: Anoint them as you anointed their father, so that they too may serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priests. Their anointing will give them a priesthood that lasts for all time, through every generation."

L.15: And you shall anoint them just as you anointed their father, and they shall serve as priests to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; and their anointing shall be to them for a priesthood forever throughout their generations."

R.15: Anoint them in the same way you anointed their father, so they can serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priests. Because they are anointed, they and their descendants will be priests for all time."

decisions.choice: their anointing ... a priesthood forever: the priesthood belongs to their family for all time
decisions.reason: The anointing of these first priests established the priesthood in Aaron's family for the generations after them, as 29:9 says (also Numbers 25:13). "Forever" means for as long as Israel continues.

decisions.choice: it will be, to be: the anointing will serve as
decisions.reason: The verb is followed by its own infinitive, a heavy construction that states what the anointing will become for them: their lasting claim to the priesthood.

decisions.choice: they and their descendants
decisions.reason: Readable says that "throughout their generations" means the sons' descendants after them.

records.source: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ס
records.gloss: And did Moses according to all that commanded Yahweh him; so he did.
pieces: Moses carried out all that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him. That is just what he did.

L.16: And Moses did according to all that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him; so he did.

R.16: Moses did everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told him to do.

decisions.choice: did according to all ... so he did: Moses' full obedience, in Noah's words
decisions.reason: The same words are said of Noah building the ark (Genesis 6:22). As Noah built what saved life through the flood, Moses builds the place where God will live among his people. The verse sums up verses 17-33.

decisions.choice: so he did: an emphatic repetition
decisions.reason: The closing words repeat the verb to stress that Moses did exactly what he was told.

decisions.choice: one clause
decisions.reason: Readable makes the doubled statement a single sentence; Literal and Balanced keep the repetition.

records.source: וַיְהִ֞י בַּחֹ֧דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הוּקַ֖ם הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
records.gloss: And it was in the month the first, in the year the second, on [the] first of the month, was set up the tabernacle.
pieces: In the second year, on the first day of the first month, the tabernacle was put up.

L.17: And it came about in the first month, in the second year, on the first of the month, the tabernacle was set up.

R.17: So the tabernacle was put up on the first day of the first month. This was in the second year after the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} left Egypt.

decisions.choice: the first month of the second year: nearly a year after the exodus
decisions.reason: The years are counted from the exodus (12:2; 19:1; Numbers 1:1). Israel left Egypt on the fifteenth day of the first month (Numbers 33:3) and came to Sinai in the third month (19:1). The tabernacle was put up two weeks short of a year after they left, and about nine months after they arrived at Sinai.

decisions.choice: was set up: the passive, before the active of verse 18
decisions.reason: The verse states the event; verses 18-33 tell how Moses did it. Numbers 7:1 and 9:15 refer back to this day.

decisions.choice: after the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} left Egypt
decisions.reason: Readable says from what the second year is counted.

records.heading: Moses sets up the tabernacle

records.source: וַיָּ֨קֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־אֲדָנָ֔יו וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת־קְרָשָׁ֔יו וַיִּתֵּ֖ן אֶת־בְּרִיחָ֑יו וַיָּ֖קֶם אֶת־עַמּוּדָֽיו׃
records.gloss: And set up Moses the tabernacle, and he put its bases, and he set up its frames, and he put its bars, and he set up its pillars.
pieces: Moses set up the tabernacle. He laid its bases, put its frames in place, fitted its crossbars and raised its pillars.

L.18: And Moses set up the tabernacle; and he put [in place] its bases, and set up its frames, and put [in] its bars, and set up its pillars.

R.18: Moses set up the tabernacle. He put its bases in place and set its frames in them. He put in the crossbars and set up its posts.

decisions.choice: bases, frames, bars, pillars: the framework of the tent
decisions.reason: The silver bases held the upright frames, the bars held the frames together, and the pillars held the veil and the entrance screen (26:15-37).

decisions.choice: crossbars
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "crossbars", as in 26:26; Literal keeps "bars".

decisions.choice: posts
decisions.reason: Readable says "posts" for the pillars, as in 27:16.

records.source: וַיִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אֶת־הָאֹ֨הֶל֙ עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וַיָּ֜שֶׂם אֶת־מִכְסֵ֥ה הָאֹ֛הֶל עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
records.gloss: And he spread out the tent over the tabernacle, and he put [the] covering of the tent over it from above, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.
pieces: He spread the tent over the tabernacle and laid the covering of the tent on top of it, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

L.19: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and he put the covering of the tent over it, above, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

R.19: He spread the outer tent of goats' hair over the tabernacle and put the leather coverings over that. He did it all just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

decisions.choice: the tent ... the covering of the tent: the layers over the tabernacle
decisions.reason: "The tabernacle" here is the inner layer of linen curtains; "the tent" is the layer of goats' hair curtains over it (26:1, 7); "the covering" is the rams' skins and fine leather on top (26:14).

decisions.choice: just as Yahweh had commanded Moses: a refrain heard seven times
decisions.reason: The words close each step of the setting up, seven times in all (verses 19, 21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 32), as the same refrain marks the making of the priests' garments (39:1-31). Seven steps, like the seven days of creation, lead to the finished work of verse 33.

decisions.choice: outer tent of goats' hair ... leather coverings
decisions.reason: Readable says what the tent and the covering were made of (26:7, 14).

records.source: וַיִּקַּ֞ח וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־הָעֵדֻת֙ אֶל־הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עַל־הָאָרֹ֑ן וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
records.gloss: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and he put the poles on the ark, and he put the mercy seat on the ark from above.
pieces: He took the testimony and placed it in the ark, fitted the poles to the ark, and set the mercy seat on top of the ark.

L.20: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and he set the poles on the ark, and he put the mercy seat on the ark, above.

R.20: He took the covenant tablets and put them inside the ark. He put the poles in place on the ark. Then he put the lid of the ark, the place where sins are covered, on top of the ark.

decisions.choice: the testimony: the stone tablets of the covenant
decisions.reason: "The testimony" is the two tablets with the Ten Words written on them (25:16; 31:18; 34:28-29), which bore witness to the covenant.

decisions.choice: the mercy seat: the gold lid of the ark, the place of atonement
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb for making atonement. It was the gold cover of the ark, with the cherubim above it, where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement (25:17-22; Leviticus 16:14-15).

decisions.choice: the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the testimony" is, as in 25:16.

decisions.choice: the lid of the ark, the place where sins are covered
decisions.reason: Readable explains "mercy seat", as in 25:17.

records.source: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֶת־הָאָרֹן֮ אֶל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֒ וַיָּ֗שֶׂם אֵ֚ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֔ךְ וַיָּ֕סֶךְ עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
records.gloss: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and he set up the veil of the screen, and he screened over [the] ark of the testimony, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.
pieces: He brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the curtain that serves as a screen, shutting off the ark of the testimony from view, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

L.21: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

R.21: He brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the inner curtain to shut off the ark that holds the covenant tablets. He did it all just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

decisions.choice: the veil of the screen: the veil that served as a screen
decisions.reason: The phrase names the veil by its purpose (35:12; 39:34): it screened the most holy place, where the ark stood, from the rest of the tent.

decisions.choice: curtain
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "curtain" (Readable "inner curtain"); Literal keeps "veil".

decisions.choice: the ark that holds the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the ark of the testimony" is.

records.source: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן צָפֹ֑נָה מִח֖וּץ לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
records.gloss: And he put the table in [the] tent of meeting, on [the] side of the tabernacle northward, outside of the veil.
pieces: He placed the table in the tent of meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the curtain.

L.22: And he put the table in the tent of meeting, on the side of the tabernacle northward, outside the veil.

R.22: He put the table in the tent of meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the inner curtain.

decisions.choice: on the north side, outside the veil: in the holy place
decisions.reason: The table stood in the outer room, the holy place, on the right as one faced the veil from the entrance on the east (26:35).

decisions.choice: curtain
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "curtain"; Literal keeps "veil".

records.source: וַיַּעֲרֹ֥ךְ עָלָ֛יו עֵ֥רֶךְ לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
records.gloss: And he arranged on it an arrangement of bread before Yahweh, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.
pieces: He set out the bread on it in rows before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

L.23: And he set in order on it an arrangement of bread before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

R.23: He laid out the bread in rows on the table in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He did this just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

decisions.choice: an arrangement of bread: the bread of the Presence in rows
decisions.reason: This is the bread of the Presence (25:30), twelve loaves set out in two rows on the table before God (Leviticus 24:5-8).

decisions.choice: set out ... in rows
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say how the bread was arranged; Literal keeps "set in order ... an arrangement".

records.source: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָה֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד נֹ֖כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֑ן עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן נֶֽגְבָּה׃
records.gloss: And he put the lampstand in [the] tent of meeting, opposite the table, on [the] side of the tabernacle southward.
pieces: He placed the lampstand in the tent of meeting across from the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

L.24: And he put the lampstand in the tent of meeting, opposite the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

R.24: He put the lampstand in the tent of meeting, across from the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: the lampstand on the south side: facing the table
decisions.reason: The gold lampstand stood in the holy place opposite the table, as 26:35 directed, giving light in the tent that had no window.

records.source: וַיַּ֥עַל הַנֵּרֹ֖ת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
records.gloss: And he set up the lamps before Yahweh, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.
pieces: He set up the lamps before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

L.25: And he set up the lamps before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

R.25: He put the lamps in place in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He did this just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

decisions.choice: set up the lamps: mount them, or light them
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up. It may mean placing the lamps on the lampstand (25:37) or lighting them so that their flame goes up (as in Numbers 8:2-3). Both happened as the tent was set up.

records.source: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הַזָּהָ֖ב בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לִפְנֵ֖י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
records.gloss: And he put [the] altar of the gold in [the] tent of meeting, before the veil,
pieces: He placed the gold altar in the tent of meeting, in front of the curtain,

L.26: And he put the altar of gold in the tent of meeting, before the veil,

R.26: He put the gold altar in the tent of meeting, in front of the inner curtain.

decisions.choice: the gold altar before the veil: the altar of incense
decisions.reason: The small altar overlaid with gold, for incense (30:1-6), stood in the holy place just outside the veil, facing the ark behind it.

decisions.choice: curtain
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "curtain"; Literal keeps "veil".

records.source: וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
records.gloss: and he burned on it incense of spices, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.
pieces: and burned sweet-smelling incense on it, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

L.27: and he burned on it incense of spices, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

R.27: He burned sweet-smelling incense on it. He did this just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

decisions.choice: incense of spices: the fragrant incense of 30:34-38
decisions.reason: The incense was made from spices by a fixed recipe and used only for God (30:34-38). It was burned on this altar every morning and evening (30:7-8).

decisions.choice: sweet-smelling
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable describe the incense, as in 30:7; Literal keeps "of spices".

records.source: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת־מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
records.gloss: And he set up the screen of the entrance to the tabernacle.
pieces: He hung the screen at the entrance to the tabernacle.

L.28: And he set up the screen of the entrance to the tabernacle.

R.28: He hung the screen at the entrance to the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: the screen of the entrance: the door hanging of the tent
decisions.reason: This is the screen at the doorway of the tent (26:36-37; verse 5), not the screen at the courtyard gate (verse 33).

decisions.choice: hung
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say how a screen is set up; Literal keeps "set up".

records.source: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה שָׂ֕ם פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֣ן אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֣עַל עָלָ֗יו אֶת־הָעֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
records.gloss: And [the] altar of the burnt offering he set [at the] entrance of [the] tabernacle of [the] tent of meeting, and he offered up on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.
pieces: He set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

L.29: And the altar of burnt offering he set [at] the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and he offered up on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

R.29: He set up the altar for burnt offerings near the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting. On it he offered the burnt offering and the grain offering. He did this just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

decisions.choice: he offered the burnt offering and the grain offering: the first offerings on the altar
decisions.reason: Moses himself made the first offerings, before Aaron and his sons were ordained (Leviticus 8). The burnt offering with its grain offering was the regular daily offering of 29:38-42.

decisions.choice: He set the altar ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the subject and verb first; Literal keeps the Hebrew order, which puts the altar first.

records.source: וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן שָׁ֛מָּה מַ֖יִם לְרָחְצָֽה׃
records.gloss: And he put the basin between [the] tent of meeting and the altar, and he put there water for washing.
pieces: Between the tent of meeting and the altar he placed the basin, and he filled it with water for washing.

L.30: And he put the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and he put water there for washing.

R.30: He put the bronze basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and filled it with water for washing.

decisions.choice: the basin ... for washing: water for the priests before they served
decisions.reason: The water was for the priests to wash before entering the tent or serving at the altar (30:19-21).

decisions.choice: bronze
decisions.reason: Readable adds what the basin was made of (30:18).

records.source: וְרָחֲצ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃
records.gloss: And washed from it Moses and Aaron and his sons their hands and their feet.
pieces: Moses, Aaron and Aaron's sons would wash their hands and feet with water from it.

L.31: And Moses and Aaron and his sons would wash their hands and their feet from it.

R.31: Moses, Aaron and Aaron's sons used it to wash their hands and feet.

decisions.choice: washed: a regular practice
decisions.reason: The form of the verb most likely describes what they did each time, as verse 32 goes on to say. It may also describe a single washing on the day the tabernacle was set up.

decisions.choice: Moses with Aaron and his sons: Moses served as priest at the ordination
decisions.reason: Moses is named with the priests because he served at the altar during the ordination (Leviticus 8:14-30).

records.source: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וּבְקָרְבָתָ֛ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִרְחָ֑צוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
records.gloss: When they went into [the] tent of meeting and when they drew near to the altar, they would wash, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.
pieces: Each time they went into the tent of meeting or came near the altar, they washed, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

L.32: When they went into the tent of meeting, and when they drew near to the altar, they would wash, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

R.32: They washed every time they went into the tent of meeting or came near the altar. This was just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

decisions.choice: they would wash, as commanded: obeying 30:19-21
decisions.reason: The washing follows the command of 30:19-21, which warned that the priests must wash so that they would not die. This is the seventh time the refrain "just as Yahweh had commanded Moses" is heard.

records.source: וַיָּ֣קֶם אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֗ר סָבִיב֙ לַמִּשְׁכָּ֣ן וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּתֵּ֕ן אֶת־מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃פ
records.gloss: And he set up the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and he put the screen of [the] gate of the courtyard. And finished Moses the work.
pieces: He put up the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung the screen for the courtyard gate. So Moses completed the work.

L.33: And he set up the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and he put [up] the screen of the gate of the courtyard. And Moses completed the work.

R.33: He set up the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung the screen at the courtyard's gate. So Moses finished the work.

decisions.choice: Moses completed the work: an echo of God completing his work at creation
decisions.reason: The verb and the noun are the ones used when God completed his work on the seventh day (Genesis 2:2). The account of the tabernacle already echoes creation: Moses saw all the work, that it was done as commanded, and blessed the people (39:32, 43; compare Genesis 1:31; 2:1-3). The tent where God will live among his people is presented as a new creation.

decisions.choice: and Moses completed: the close of the work
decisions.reason: The short clause ends the account of the building begun in chapter 35 and leads straight into God's coming to fill the tent (verse 34).

records.source: וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
records.gloss: And covered the cloud [the] tent of meeting, and [the] glory of Yahweh filled the tabernacle.
pieces: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the tabernacle was filled with the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

L.34: And the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the tabernacle.

R.34: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the tabernacle became full of the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

decisions.choice: the glory of Yahweh filled the tabernacle: God comes to dwell among his people
decisions.reason: This is what the whole tabernacle was made for. God told Moses, "Let them make me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell among them" (25:8), and promised, "I will dwell among the sons of Israel and be their God" (29:45-46). Now he does: his glory, his visible presence, fills the dwelling built for him. After the golden calf, when his presence among the people was in doubt (33:3, 15-16), this is the proof that he has forgiven them and will go with them. The same happens when Solomon's temple is finished (1 Kings 8:10-11).

decisions.choice: the cloud covered ... the glory: what happened on Sinai now happens at the tent
decisions.reason: At Sinai the cloud covered the mountain, the glory of Yahweh settled on it, and Moses went up into the cloud (24:15-18). The same cloud and glory now come down on the tent, so that the presence once on the mountain goes with Israel wherever they travel.

decisions.choice: the cloud: the pillar of cloud
decisions.reason: The article points to the known cloud, the pillar of cloud that had led Israel since they left Egypt (13:21-22; 14:19-20; 16:10).

records.heading: The cloud and the glory

records.source: וְלֹא־יָכֹ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לָבוֹא֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד כִּֽי־שָׁכַ֥ן עָלָ֖יו הֶעָנָ֑ן וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
records.gloss: And not was able Moses to go into [the] tent of meeting, because had settled over it the cloud, and [the] glory of Yahweh filled the tabernacle.
pieces: Moses was unable to go into the tent of meeting, since the cloud had come to rest on it and the tabernacle was full of the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

L.35: And Moses was not able to go into the tent of meeting, because the cloud had settled on it and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the tabernacle.

R.35: Moses could not go inside the tent of meeting. The cloud had come to stay on it, and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: settled: came to rest and stay
decisions.reason: The verb means to settle and dwell. It is the root of the word "tabernacle" (dwelling) and the verb of God's promise to dwell among his people (25:8; 29:45-46). The same verb is used of the glory settling on Sinai (24:16).

decisions.choice: Moses was not able to enter: the glory is too great even for Moses
decisions.reason: On Sinai Moses went into the cloud (24:18), but here even he cannot enter while the glory fills the tent. The next book begins with God calling to Moses from the tent of meeting (Leviticus 1:1), and the same thing happens to the priests at the temple (1 Kings 8:11).

decisions.choice: had come to stay
decisions.reason: Readable says that the cloud came to remain, not only to stop for a moment.

records.source: וּבְהֵעָל֤וֹת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
records.gloss: And when was taken up the cloud from over the tabernacle, set out [the] sons of Israel in all their settings out.
pieces: Whenever the cloud rose from over the tabernacle, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} broke camp and moved on, at every stage of their journeys.

L.36: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel would set out, in all their journeys.

R.36: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} packed up their camp and moved on. They did this all through their travels.

decisions.choice: set out: pull up stakes and move on
decisions.reason: The verb means to pull up tent pegs and break camp. The related noun at the end of the verse means the stages of a journey, from one camp to the next.

decisions.choice: when ... in all their journeys: what happened every time
decisions.reason: The verse describes a regular pattern, not a single event: at every stage of their travels the people waited for the cloud. Verses 36-38 look past the end of the book to the whole journey through the wilderness.

decisions.choice: broke camp and moved on
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what setting out involved; Literal keeps "set out".

records.source: וְאִם־לֹ֥א יֵעָלֶ֖ה הֶעָנָ֑ן וְלֹ֣א יִסְע֔וּ עַד־י֖וֹם הֵעָלֹתֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: And if not was taken up the cloud, then not they set out until [the] day it was taken up.
pieces: If the cloud stayed where it was, they stayed too, until the day it rose.

L.37: And if the cloud was not taken up, then they would not set out until the day it was taken up.

R.37: If the cloud did not lift, they stayed where they were. They waited until the day it lifted.

decisions.choice: if not ... until the day: they waited for the cloud
decisions.reason: The verse is the other half of verse 36: the people did not move until God moved. Numbers 9:19-22 tells how they stayed for days, months or longer while the cloud remained.

decisions.choice: stayed too
decisions.reason: Balanced says what not setting out meant, staying in camp; Literal keeps "would not set out".

records.source: כִּי֩ עֲנַ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְאֵ֕שׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַ֖יְלָה בּ֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
records.gloss: For [the] cloud of Yahweh [was] over the tabernacle by day, and fire was by night in it, to [the] eyes of all [the] house of Israel in all their journeys.
pieces: By day the cloud of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rested over the tabernacle, and by night fire glowed within it. The whole house of Israel could see it, at every stage of their travels.

L.38: For the cloud of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [was] over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, before the eyes of all the house of Israel, in all their journeys.

R.38: During the day the cloud of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stayed over the tabernacle, and at night there was fire in the cloud. All the people of Israel could see it the whole time they traveled.

decisions.choice: the cloud of Yahweh ... in all their journeys: the book ends with God present and leading
decisions.reason: Exodus began with Israel enslaved in Egypt, building cities for Pharaoh (1:11). It ends with Israel free, and with God living in the tent they built for him, seen by the whole people day and night, leading them on. The verse looks ahead past Sinai: Numbers 9:15-23 tells the same story in more detail, and Numbers 10:11-12 tells of the first time the cloud lifted and Israel set out from Sinai.

decisions.choice: fire was in it: in the cloud
decisions.reason: "It" most likely refers to the cloud, which shone with fire at night, as the pillar of cloud and fire did from the start (13:21-22; Numbers 9:15-16). It may also refer to the tabernacle, over which the fire appeared.

decisions.choice: to the eyes of all the house of Israel: in plain sight of the whole people
decisions.reason: "To the eyes of" means in full view of. "The house of Israel" is the whole people, Israel's household.

decisions.choice: all the people of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says "people" for "house"; Literal and Balanced keep "house of Israel".

decisions.choice: glowed
decisions.reason: Balanced describes the fire at night; Literal says only that fire "was" in it.
